nativeLimitation.directMirror: Measured native mirrorOptions:{version:1} supports up to 21 categories; this registered scaffold retains its two horizontal native panels.
nativeLimitation.implementation: two native horizontal bar graphs; positive values, left graph flipped horizontally; only age labels/axes/ticks/captions supplemented

male.order: oldest first; consecutive five-year bins, youngest 0~4

female.order: oldest first; consecutive five-year bins, youngest 0~4

ageTickInterval.description: Show only numeric ages at this interval plus (세); omission preserves alternating age-range labels. Values/bars retain every category.

ageLabelPosition.description: Omit/center preserves the center age column. left uses one editable native mirror graph, a shared zero, 0/4/8/12 ticks, captions 1mm below tick ink, and final (%) at right.

barGap.description: Left age-axis variant only: fraction of each age row reserved as gap; omitted/0 joins adjacent classes. ageTickInterval defaults to 20 in this variant.

sizingEvidence.note: No DPI metadata; proposed width from reference ink/text proportions with unchanged 8pt text (mixed graph 7pt). Not a recovered PDF placement measurement. Native measurement and rendered review remain required.
